requirements.normative_requirement: Every arbitrary process call receives fresh PID, mount, IPC, network, and UTS namespaces.
requirements.primary_verification: Namespace inode comparison and cross-cell IPC/abstract-socket tests.

requirements.normative_requirement: No untrusted instruction executes before atomic placement in its per-call cgroup using clone3(CLONE_INTO_CGROUP).
requirements.primary_verification: Instrument first instruction and descendant creation; reject kernels/backends without the primitive.

requirements.normative_requirement: Execution cells have empty capabilities, no_new_privs, disabled core dumps, and a bounded seccomp policy.
requirements.threat_or_failure: Privilege gain and host/guest attack surface
requirements.primary_verification: Capability, setuid, file-capability, ptrace, keyring, and forbidden-syscall canaries.

requirements.normative_requirement: Each call receives private temporary, HOME, XDG, runtime, and shared-memory state.
requirements.primary_verification: Write marker data in one call and prove subsequent calls cannot observe it outside /workspace and named per-lease caches.

requirements.normative_requirement: The workload user cannot read, write, signal, ptrace, or reach the trusted guest agent or control channel.
requirements.primary_verification: UID, procfs, ptrace, filesystem, and channel reachability adversarial tests.

requirements.normative_requirement: A clean terminal result requires cgroup.kill capability and recursive cgroup.events populated=0 proof.
requirements.primary_verification: Double-fork, setsid, orphan, fork bomb, and cancellation campaign.

requirements.normative_requirement: Cancellation uses terminate, bounded grace, recursive cgroup kill, and descendant-empty proof; uncertainty quarantines the lease.
requirements.primary_verification: Cancel at each process state and inject cleanup failures.
